phase: Explicit owner direction makes AnyTour Design System 1.0 and whole-site visual unification Priority #1. Do not confuse the mature search-product engineering score with public-site coherence. Production, lead-loss and incorrect-data defects still preempt planned visual work.

owner_priority_lock.rule: Keep Design System 1.0/site-wide visual unification first until the owner explicitly changes priority. Technical refactor continues only as supporting work or when it removes a concrete blocker.

scores.rule: Whole-site score may move only after representative production visual evidence; never inherit search-only scores.

target.design_system_goal: one coherent product from homepage through destination/search/results/tour/lead

current_task.progress: Shared editorial rhythm and content tokens are production baseline from PRs #325/#326. PR #330 unifies section-heading, copy, surface/card and action geometry between the homepage and shell-based editorial pages through one final shared-content primitive layer; pre-merge standalone/search/selected-tour/security/browser regressions are green and production verification is the current release gate.
current_task.next_action: After PR #330 production five-width evidence, audit shared header/footer wrapping and density across /, /poisk-turov/, /hot/, /contacts/, /how-to-buy/, /rb/, /country/ and representative countries; fix the weakest confirmed cross-page inconsistency, then continue through destination → search → results → selected tour → lead continuity.

work_order: verify PR #330 production deploy and 375/430/768/1024/1440 evidence
audit and unify shared header/navigation active state, wrapping and geometry across public/search pages
audit shared footer/community density, wrapping and spacing across all public page families
continue shared typography, section, card, button and breadcrumb primitives where page-specific drift remains
audit representative country and hot pages against homepage/search visual language
verify end-to-end homepage → destination/hot → search → results → selected tour → lead visual continuity
run technical refactor only where it directly supports safer Design System migration or after the visual gate

deferred.reason: Keep compatibility-layer approach until an atomic swap has equivalent browser coverage.
Requires deliberate publication/indexing contract; not part of visual unification.
Separate DB/platform architecture; keep deferred without fresh safety review.

continuation_policy.priority: production_broken > lead_loss > incorrect_data > broken_user_journey > design_system_sitewide_visual > supporting_technical_refactor > content_seo > cosmetic_cleanup
